description: Instructions in the Agent Skills format that agents load when their task needs them. A skill never grants tools, and scripts in it are never run.
emptyText: Import a skill as a ZIP file or as a single SKILL.md file. Agents then use it in a fixed version.
selectHint: Select a skill to see its instructions, files and versions and where it is used.
viewing: You are looking at version {{version}}. The current version is {{latest}}.
disabled: “{{name}}” is disabled. Agents that use it cannot run until you activate it again.
truncated: The file is long: only its beginning is shown.

importDialog.title: Import skill
importDialog.security: Imported skills come from an unknown source. Their instructions are given to the model as untrusted content, and scripts in them are never run. Check the content before you use the skill with tools that write or change data.
importDialog.fileHint: A ZIP file with one skill folder, or a single SKILL.md file. Nothing is stored before you confirm.
importDialog.errors_one: {{count}} error prevents the import. Fix it in the file and choose it again.
importDialog.errors_other: {{count}} errors prevent the import. Fix them in the file and choose it again.
importDialog.warnings_one: {{count}} warning. The skill can be imported anyway.
importDialog.warnings_other: {{count}} warnings. The skill can be imported anyway.
importDialog.existing: A skill named “{{name}}” already exists (version {{version}}). The import stores this file as its next version.

editDialog.title: Edit SKILL.md of {{name}}
editDialog.hint: Saving stores a new version with this SKILL.md; all other files stay as they are. The name cannot change here: copy the skill under a new name instead.
editDialog.truncated: SKILL.md is too long to be edited here. Edit the file outside Nodestro and import it as a new version.

copyDialog.title: Copy {{name}}
copyDialog.name: Name of the copy
copyDialog.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.
